items.source: This is basically a JSR-330 compliant variant of Spring's good old ObjectFactoryCreatingFactoryBean. It can be used for traditional external dependency injection configuration that targets a property or constructor argument of type jakarta.inject.Provider, as an alternative to JSR-330's @Inject annotation-driven approach.
items.translation: 这基本上是 Spring 经典的 ObjectFactoryCreatingFactoryBean 的符合 JSR-330 规范的变体。它可用于传统的基于外部依赖注入的配置，针对类型为 jakarta.inject.Provider 的属性或构造函数参数，作为 JSR-330 的 @Inject 注解驱动方法的替代方案。

items.source: Eagerly create the singleton instance, if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，急切地创建单例实例。

items.source: Invoked on initialization of this FactoryBean in case of a singleton; else, on each AbstractFactoryBean.getObject() call.
items.translation: 在单例的情况下，在本 FactoryBean 初始化时调用；否则，在每次 `AbstractFactoryBean.getObject()` 调用时。

items.source: The target does not have to be a non-singleton bean, but realistically always will be (because if the target bean were a singleton, then said singleton bean could simply be injected straight into the dependent object, thus obviating the need for the extra level of indirection afforded by this factory approach).
items.translation: 目标对象不必是非单例 Bean，但现实中几乎总是如此（因为如果目标 Bean 是单例的，那么该单例 Bean 可以直接注入到依赖对象中，从而消除了这种工厂方法所提供的额外一层间接性的需要）。
